about.title: Brihaspathi Technologies
about.description: An AI-powered mission-critical technology company with capabilities spanning proprietary product engineering, electronics manufacturing, software platforms, AI video intelligence and nationwide project execution.
about.vision: To become one of the India’s leading AI-powered mission-critical technology companies with global relevance.
about.mission: To build an AI-powered mission-critical technology enterprise combining the proprietary hardware, software, AI platforms, electronics manufacturing and managed services for Defence, Public Safety, Railways, Mobility and Critical Infrastructure.

items.title: Smart Bus Solutions
items.description: Our smart bus systems combine AI CCTV, GPS tracking, Wi-Fi, displays, breath analysis, and analytics for public transport. Real-time monitoring supports passenger safety and fleet oversight, while route insights help operators improve service efficiency. Optional features include pedestrian blind-spot detection and driver fatigue monitoring.

items.title: Sustainable Energy Revolution: Solar EPC Excellence
items.description: Our Solar EPC service delivers turnkey solar power projects for residential, commercial, and industrial clients. We manage site assessments, engineering and system design, procurement of quality components, construction, grid integration, testing, and commissioning. Quality checks and project management help ensure reliable performance, streamlined delivery, and lasting renewable energy benefits.

items.title: Software Products & Services
items.description: We develop software for communication, automation, and business management, including web and app development, IoT applications, E-Communication, and ERP systems. Solutions such as Biz Track ERP help streamline operations, support customer engagement, and provide insights for growing businesses.

items.title: HRMS
items.description: Brihaspathi's HRMS centralizes employee records and supports recruitment, onboarding, attendance, leave, payroll, performance, and document management. Workflow automation, biometric integration, notifications, dashboards, and employee self-service help HR teams streamline everyday processes and maintain visibility across the employee lifecycle.

items.title: AI Visitor Management System
items.description: Improve facility security with AI facial recognition, visitor identification, and multi-camera tracking. The system supports digital registration, QR visitor passes, and approval workflows, while a centralized dashboard helps security teams monitor visitor activity, movement, alerts, and events across the premises.

items.title: Command & Control Centre Engineering
items.description: We design and build Integrated Command & Control Centres (ICCCs) with video walls, operator consoles, monitoring platforms, and backend infrastructure. These integrated environments give teams real-time visibility to coordinate operations, monitor incidents, and make informed decisions across connected systems.
